items.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
items.summary: The paper explores how to embed continuous-space latent reasoning into unified multimodal models to improve image generation via chain-of-thought methods.
items.whyItMatters: It could enable more controllable, scalable multimodal AI, benefiting developers building advanced image‑generation tools.

items.title: Flide: Accelerating Decision Inference with Exact State Forking
items.summary: Flide introduces exact state forking to speed up decision inference in LLM agents, reducing recomputation and preserving accurate probabilities.
items.whyItMatters: It boosts efficiency and reliability for rapid categorical reasoning in AI systems.

items.title: Latent Sparse Attention: Towards Subquadratic Ultra-Long Context Attention
items.summary: The paper proposes Latent Sparse Attention, a method to enable subquadratic attention for ultra-long (1M+ token) contexts by selecting key subsets.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because it could drastically reduce compute for large‑scale language models, enabling more efficient long‑form reasoning.

items.title: Hierarchical World Models with Implicit Dynamics
items.summary: The paper proposes ID-WM, a hierarchical world model that learns implicit dynamics for better long-horizon planning in embodied agents.
items.whyItMatters: It promises more robust, fine-grained control and improved generalization for complex tasks.

items.title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
items.summary: The paper presents RoboArchitect, a system that automatically generates agent harnesses for frozen robot policies, enabling efficient control without manual redesign.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because it reduces engineering effort and speeds deployment of reusable robotic control systems.

items.title: Counting on Dummies: Privacy Amplification with Observable Counts and Truncated Batches
items.summary: The article explains how random batch sampling in DP-SGD, especially with variable batch sizes, improves privacy through amplification techniques.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because it offers tighter privacy guarantees for machine learning models on sensitive data.

items.title: A Better Critic Matters for Distribution Matching Distillation
items.summary: The paper studies how the capacity and information of an online critic affect training signals in Distribution Matching Distillation for student models on ImageNet.
items.whyItMatters: Understanding critic design improves efficient distillation, enabling smaller models with better performance.

items.title: Instance-dependent sequential limits as an exact information ledger
items.summary: The paper unifies instance-dependent lower bounds for bandit problems, sequential tests, best-arm identification, and MDPs using a single analytical chain.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers gain a single framework to derive tight performance limits across diverse sequential decision tasks.

items.title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
items.summary: DecisionRank distills ranking knowledge from a generative LLM into a fast decision model by aligning teacher rankings with student first-token scores.
items.whyItMatters: It reduces latency for structured tasks while preserving LLM ranking quality.

items.title: Physiological Trajectories and Observation Patterns in ICU Mortality Prediction: Transportability Under Changing Measurement Conditions
items.summary: The study evaluates how physiological trends versus observation timing influence ICU mortality predictions across different datasets.
items.whyItMatters: It informs model design for robust, transportable ICU risk tools.

items.title: Gradient Descent on Two ReLU Neurons: Global Landscape and Bifurcation Dynamics
items.summary: The paper analyzes gradient descent dynamics in a two‑ReLU neuron teacher‑student model with Gaussian inputs, revealing complex multi‑phase behavior.
items.whyItMatters: It offers insights into feature learning and convergence challenges for small‑initialized neural nets.

items.title: Fast Privacy Loss Accounting for Random Allocation via Multiscale FFT
items.summary: The paper presents a faster privacy loss accountant for random allocation sampling, reducing runtime from quadratic to near-linear in the accuracy parameter.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers benefit from more efficient differential privacy tools for large-scale, communication‑efficient data aggregation.

items.title: ACCT: Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer
items.summary: In real-world deployments, large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly evolving from single-model invocation toward heterogeneous deployments in which different models are dynamically invoked for inference. items.summary: Atmospheric fronts are associated with much of the high-impact weather in the mid-latitudes, yet their identification and classification remain largely manual and subjective. items.summary: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) seeks to infer the reward function underlying observed behavior, but its predictive accuracy and interpretability depend on how that reward is computed from the underlying features. items.title: Towards Understanding the Impact of Plasticity Loss on Reinforcement Learning in Stochastic Environments
items.summary: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework for sequential decision-making. Despite many high-profile successes in recent years, deep RL is known to be brittle. An emerging line of research attributes this brittleness to a loss of plasticity in neural networks. However, plasticity loss has so far been understudied in stochastic environments. items.title: CausalWAM: Learning the Causes of Actions in World Action Models
items.summary: World action models (WAMs) learn latent variables from observations and use these to both predict the evolution of the scene and to generate actions. The prediction has to be of the whole scene, whereas only a portion of the scene causes actions.
